sentences.text: After making brief submissions, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner would first press her claim for rehabilitation before the District Magistrate by moving additional representation before him.

He places reliance on the Second Schedule to the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 particularly the clause in row No. (iii) which relates to offer of developed land to the affected families.
